name: splashtest
description: Review the current diff along several dimensions and keep only findings that survive a refutation pass

nodes.name: args
nodes.logic: What to review: a branch, a pull request or a path. With none, the current diff.

nodes.name: scout diff
nodes.logic: Cheap and mechanical. Its list of dimensions is the work-list for the pipeline.

knobs.prompt: Read the diff and split the review into dimensions (bugs, security, performance, tests), each with the files it concerns

nodes.name: review
nodes.logic: Each dimension flows through both stages on its own; a fast dimension starts verifying while slow ones still review.

knobs.prompt: Review the diff for this dimension only and report concrete findings with evidence
knobs.output: { findings: [{ file, line, severity, claim, evidence }] }

children.name: verify findings
children.logic: 3 votes: each skeptic tries to refute a finding and defaults to refuted when unsure. Keep a finding only if at least 2 of 3 fail to refute it.

knobs.prompt: Try to refute this finding against the actual code

nodes.name: synthesize
nodes.logic: Runs once over all surviving findings: merge duplicates, order by severity, say what was dropped.

knobs.prompt: Write one review from the confirmed findings of every dimension
